config._description: Classic noir detective story - gritty, atmospheric, morally complex
config.characters: Jack Malone (45, weathered detective, ex-cop turned PI), Veronica Steele (32, femme fatale, nightclub owner), Tommy 'The Knife' Russo (38, mob enforcer), Eddie Chen (28, murdered informant), Captain Morrison (55, corrupt police captain)
config.relationships: Veronica hired Jack to find her missing brother Eddie. Tommy works for the mob boss who ordered the hit. Morrison is on the mob's payroll and trying to bury the case. Jack and Veronica develop a dangerous attraction.
config.betrayals: Morrison betrayed the police force for money, Veronica initially lied about her brother's criminal connections, Tommy betrayed Eddie who was his childhood friend
config.art_style: Classic noir - high contrast black and white, dramatic shadows, rain-slicked streets, cigarette smoke, venetian blind shadows
config.setting: 1947, Los Angeles - smoky jazz clubs, rain-soaked alleys, seedy hotels, corrupt police stations
config.theme: Moral ambiguity, corruption, redemption, the price of truth
config.tone: Dark, cynical, atmospheric, morally complex with moments of humanity

skipper._description: Control which stages use mock/cached data vs actual generation
skipper._note: p=plotbuilder, c=critique, e=eval, w=writer(screenplay/book), s=storyboard(chapters). true=skip/mock, false=generate
